script:
set -e
TOK=$(cat ~/.cache/huggingface/token)
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
if [ -d /workspace/kazbek-tiles/.git ]; then (cd /workspace/kazbek-tiles && timeout 60 git fetch -q origin main && git reset -q --hard origin/main); else git clone -q https://github.com/GauchoAI/kazbek-tiles /workspace/kazbek-tiles; fi
curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/n5.ply https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/checkpoints/kazbek-run-n-mip/kazbek-run-n-mip.ply
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
STAGE=/workspace/kt5-stage-n/world/kazbek-c10
mkdir -p $STAGE
cd /workspace/kazbek-tiles
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --node-modules-dir=auto encode/build-tiles.ts /tmp/n5.ply $STAGE/tiles5-n-g48 --grid 48 --sh 1
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-net --node-modules-dir=auto decode/verify-tiles.ts $STAGE/tiles5-n-g48 /tmp/n5.ply | tail -2
python3 -c "from huggingface_hub import HfApi; HfApi().upload_large_folder(folder_path='/workspace/kt5-stage-n', repo_id='miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets', repo_type='dataset', print_report=False)"
echo KT5-N-DONE
